description: This source file contains unit tests for the SchemaOnlyTuner class within the org.openmrs.liquibase package. The tests validate functionality such as creating updated changelog files, detaching Liquibase tables, and replacing specific database column types within XML documents.

classes.name: SchemaOnlyTunerTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the SchemaOnlyTuner functionalities, including XML manipulation and database schema changes within Liquibase changelogs.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes test fixtures before each test method, including reading sample XML documents and instantiating the SchemaOnlyTuner.

methods.name: shouldCreateUpdatedChangeLogFile
methods.description: Verifies that the SchemaOnlyTuner can create an updated changelog file matching the expected snapshot.

methods.name: shouldDetachChangeSetsForLiquibaseTables
methods.description: Tests removing Liquibase-specific tables from the changelog XML document.

methods.name: shouldReplaceBitTypeWithBooleanType
methods.description: Ensures the replacement of 'BIT' column types with 'BOOLEAN' in the XML document.

methods.name: shouldReplaceLongtextTypeWithClobType
methods.description: Checks that 'LONGTEXT' types are correctly replaced with 'CLOB' types and that the appropriate assertion method is invoked.

methods.name: shouldAssertLongtextNode
methods.description: Validates the assertion logic for nodes representing 'LONGTEXT' columns.

methods.name: shouldDetectWrongNumberOfLongtextNodes
methods.description: Verifies that an assertion error is thrown when the number of 'LONGTEXT' nodes does not match expectations.

methods.name: shouldDetectWrongGrandParentNodeOfLongtextNode
methods.description: Checks that an assertion error is thrown when the 'LONGTEXT' node's parent node is incorrect.
